identity.title: A Superluminous Supernova in High Surface Density Molecular Gas within the Bar of a Metal-rich Galaxy

paper_type_evidence.quote: We used the Band-3 receivers of the ALMA 12-m Array in C43-6 configuration to map the CO(1-0) emission of the host galaxy

question.value: Does the SLSN PTF10tpz progenitor form in dense molecular gas, and what are the distribution and kinematics of molecular gas in its metal-rich barred host?

evidence.quote: In this letter we study the properties of molecular gas, the fuel for star formation, in the close environment of this SLSN, and investigate whether its progenitor is formed in a dense environment.
(project code: 2017.1.01568.S; PI: Arabsalmani)

findings_qualitative.value: CO is confined to the bar, consistent with two gas lanes ending in an inner structure likely tied to an inner Lindblad resonance

evidence.quote: These gas lanes end in a gaseous structure in the inner region of the galaxy, likely associated with an inner Lindblad resonance.

claims.hypothesis: High-density molecular gas favours SLSN progenitor formation
claims.experiment: Measured Sigma_mol at beam scale around SLSN location
claims.result: ~700 Msun/pc^2 at SLSN, up to ~1400 in inner region
claims.finding: Densities comparable to starbursts support dense-environment progenitors

evidence.quote: This lends support to high densities being favorable conditions for formation of SLSNe progenitors.

claims.hypothesis: Bar-driven gas flows set up the SLSN environment
claims.experiment: Moment maps, channel maps and PV diagram
claims.result: X-shaped PV pattern and two lanes into an inner structure
claims.finding: Lanes plausibly meet an inner resonance ring near the SLSN

evidence.quote: Note that deeper observations with higher spatial resolutions are required in order to precisely determine the location of the resonance.

limitations_admitted.value: Data do not allow detailed dynamical modelling of the galaxy

evidence.quote: The existing observations do not provide enough information on the pattern speed of the bar, the epicycle frequency, and the mass distribution

referee_caveats_inferred: alpha_CO assumed; central value may be 2x lower
Lane/resonance interpretation qualitative, no dynamical model
Progenitor mass depends on uncertain lifetime relations and assumed orbital speed

missing_for_reproduction: Moment-map and surface-density procedures in detail
reproducibility.score_reason: Single public project and simple analysis, but imaging and processing details are sparse.
